findings.defect: The Korean states that the dead and the living—all of it—evaporated. “Else” shifts the scope beyond them, and “seemed” adds uncertainty absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 그 모든 것이 증발하고 refers to everything just named—the dead and the living—evaporating, not merely seeming to vanish.

findings.current: As one of the enemies, unable to wait any longer, charged us, I kicked him in the chest and caved it in.
findings.defect: The translation omits that the enemy forces had already been greatly reduced by the earlier strike, though many still remained in the rear.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly establishes both the reduced numbers and the substantial force still in the rear before describing the charging enemy.
findings.replacement: Though the earlier strike had greatly thinned their ranks, plenty of the enemy’s forces still remained in the rear. As one of them charged before he could hold back, I kicked him in the chest and caved it in.

summary: The assembled translation is largely faithful, with two minor omissions or shifts in the scene description.
